# MathJax 3.2.2

`tex-svg-full.js` is the official MathJax 3.2.2 full TeX/SVG bundle.
Source: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/mathjax@3.2.2/es5/tex-svg-full.js
License: Apache-2.0; see LICENSE.

Served from this website to avoid depending on an external CDN or web fonts
for normal mathematical notation. Keep this bundle and its license together.
